qfvesmhj.sourceDescription: This Artificial Christmas Tree with LED is designed to bring the spirit of the festive season into your home with its sleek and modern appearance. Its cone-shaped design and dynamic LED light show make it a stunning centerpiece for your seasonal decor, perfect for creating a winter wonderland in both indoor and sheltered outdoor spaces. Crafted from abrasion-resistant materials like PVC and steel, this tree provides a durable and lasting addition to your holiday celebrations. Materials: This tree is crafted from PVC and steel, ensuring an abrasion-resistant and long-lasting build. The materials are selected to maintain their appearance over time, bringing joy year after year without wear. Included Components: It includes an LED string light with dynamic lighting patterns and a USB plug, making it easy to illuminate the space with vibrant lights. A sturdy steel stand is provided to keep the tree stable. Features /Function /Design: With eight LED flash modes, the lighting offers multiple visual experiences, from steady to dynamic displays, allowing you to customize the ambiance according to your mood or event. Recommended Uses: Suitable for the living room, garden, and terrace, this tree's versatility in design shines in any setting, enhancing the festive atmosphere wherever placed. Care &Maintenance: Assemble according to the manufacturer's instructions using a screwdriver. The non-traditional USB plug offers a universal power source connection, ensuring easy setup and teardown. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

cwj47q7w.sourceDescription: This elegant Artificial Christmas Tree blends modern style with traditional charm, featuring a sleek cone shape that enhances its visual appeal. Designed to be adorned with warm white decorative LED lights, it brings festive charm to any room or terrace, creating a cozy ambiance for the Christmas season. With a theme dedicated to Christmas, this tree is suitable for various holiday settings, providing a delightful focal point for indoor or outdoor decor. Its clean lines and minimal ornamentation complement contemporary living spaces while offering a functional holiday solution for families, event hosts, and festive enthusiasts. PVC and PE Materials: This tree is crafted from premium PE and PVC materials, ensuring both durability and an authentic look. These materials are known for being flame retardant, adding a layer of safety to your holiday setup. The tree maintains a vibrant green appearance without fading, providing an evergreen display that lasts all season. The combination of these materials brings realism to your festive decorations, offering a reliable and attractive solution for annual celebrations. Decorative LED String Lights: Equipped with warm white LED string lights, this tree illuminates your space with a gentle glow. The lights come with 8 flash modes, allowing you to adjust the lighting to fit your mood—whether you’re hosting a festive gathering or enjoying a silent night in. This lighting feature also enhances the tree’s ornamental value, making it a standout piece in your holiday décor. USB Power Source: This tree includes a USB power source, offering flexibility in where it can be displayed indoors or outdoors.
